subject: English
passage: According to geochemists Datu Ishikawa and Ingrid Dalton of the Kyoto Institute of Earth Sciences, the rate of mineral crystallization in magma chambers may be linked to heat exchange between two rock layers, the upper crustal zone and the lower mantle boundary. Crystals tend to form more rapidly when heat transfer between the layers is intensified, whereas they develop more slowly when heat transfer is ______.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice A is the best answer because 'reduced' (meaning decreased) most logically completes the contrast the passage sets up. The passage states that crystals form more rapidly when heat transfer between the two rock layers is intensified, or strengthened. The conjunction 'whereas' signals a contrast, so the condition associated with slower crystal formation must be the opposite of intensified — that is, decreased or reduced.
